notes: Open is treated as on and closed as off. The food/pantry cupboard exposes two independently moving leaves between t=720 and t=736, so they are counted separately; their rapid, partly obscured closure around t=928–936 makes the leaf-specific off timing approximate. The bedroom entry/navigation door opens near t=1480 but no later return-to-closed transition is visible through t=2115, so it is not emitted as a complete on/off episode.
scene_description: First-person fisheye traversal of an apartment kitchen and adjoining living and bedroom areas. Complete interactions involve appliance doors, a utensil drawer, upper cupboards, utility and laundry closets, and a bedroom clothes closet.
